privacy.collect: Your phone number. Anything you report, including any photo or voice note. Your location, only at the moment you send a report - never in the background.
privacy.delete: Ask your Divisional Secretariat, or raise a grievance in this app. Records tied to a payment cannot be deleted while an audit is open, and we will tell you if that applies.
privacy.keep: Reports and assessments are kept for seven years, because compensation can be audited years later. Voice notes are kept for one year.
privacy.note: This is a prototype. No live government system is connected and no real payment is made.
privacy.share: Responders see your report and where it came from, so they can reach you. Your GN officer sees damage recorded for your household. The public dashboard shows district totals only - never your name, never your location, never your amount.
privacy.title: What we collect, and who sees it
